_notes: payments-services (PSV) corpus. .NET 8 / xUnit / RestSharp / HttpClient+Polly / Serilog. Java-shaped archetypes (NET-XUN-13, NET-XUN-14) are deliberately NOT .NET: they mirror byte-identical JVM Infra Healthcheck / WSU confirmed-mode text into the PSV project for cross-project isolation (S45). Placeholders are in {curly_braces} and enumerated per archetype in 'placeholders'.

archetypes.label: pb
archetypes.title: FX historical rate uses opening instead of closing rate

info_logs.template: [STEP] Requesting closing FX rate for {base_ccy}/{quote_ccy} on value date {rate_date}
Deserialized RateResponse: open={actual_rate}, close={expected_rate}, source={source}, asOf={rate_date}T17:00:00Z
